card: g की दो आवाज़ें: page में ‘ज’ (giraffe), pig में ‘ग’ (glass)। अक्सर e, i, y से पहले g ‘ज’ बोलता है।
g ki do awaazein: page mein ‘j’ (giraffe), pig mein ‘g’ (glass). Aksar e, i, y se pehle g ‘j’ bolta hai.
g has two sounds: ‘j’ as in page (giraffe) and ‘g’ as in pig (glass). Before e, i or y, g often sounds like j.
